d:
Na paneer, na cheese! Raat ke bache chawal se spongy, jaalidaar, chatpata nashta Bache Chawal Ka Nashta
Sirf chawal, dahi, besan aur sooji se, bina fry, bina lahsun pyaaz ke.
Masala Kitchen mein Poonam Devnani ki tried & tested recipe, tiffin aur chai time dono ke liye.
Bache chawal ka spongy, paneer jaisa nashta ghar par banana seekhein
Smooth chawal-besan-dahi paste aur sooji ka perfect batter
15 minute steam, 5 minute rest aur jaalidaar cutting ki trick
Til, rai, curry leaves aur pav bhaji masala wala chatpata tadka
